title: Pf2e Dot's Fan Errata
description: Inofficial errata for my home games. Feel free to use them too.

spellfocus.label: Spell Focus
spellfocus.description:
An item that enhances your spell attacks.

You can only invest one spell focus per day. You cannot invest a spell focus of a level higher than yours.

practiced.label: Practiced
practiced.description:
This spell gets easier the more you use it.

If this spell is at least two ranks below the highest rank spell you can cast, reduce the actions it takes to cast by 1. This applies only to the first Practiced spell you cast each round.

extract.label: Extract
extract.description:
This spell can draw out the power from an alchemical consumable.

The spell gains its Extract effect if you expend a worn or held alchemical consumable that fulfills the requirements specified in the spell's Extract entry.

covenant.label: Covenant
covenant.description:
Covenant feats are a type of story-based bonus feats that represent allegiance to a faith, an organization or a set of ideals or practices.

Covenant feats have three ranks: Initiate, Devotee and Paragon. Rank advancements are formulated intentionally vaguely, but should each constitute a significant moment in the story.
